svg.title: AI Collaboration Record — All time
svg.desc: 1300 AI-attributed commits, 1347 AI actor presences across 116 active AI days (author dates), 3 AI providers. Voxel collaboration landscape 2026-06-15 to 2026-09-06, peak day 55 commits (2026-08-29); linear scale 0 to 60 commits/day; dual pillars encode AI-attributed and Other commits; publishable dates only. Generated 2026-09-06.
